title: TAI bounded partial deployment recovery
objective: Recover exactly one failed first-time standalone TAI materialization left after rollback authority was unavailable: prove the newer exact-main API/Web baseline, bind the orphan state to the exact partial TAI container and root-owned metadata, capture bounded health evidence, remove only that TAI service, restore the previously-absent protected env/override and drop only a controller-created least-privilege tai_runtime role while retaining forward-only schema/bootstrap data.
boundaries: Recovery is owner-command only on issue 3365 and requires exact current main
Current API and Web must both be healthy and exact current main before any recovery mutation
Exactly one isolated rootless no-public-port TAI container and exactly one matching root-owned MUTATION_STARTED state root are required
The orphan target must differ from the newer current main and PREVIOUS_TAI must be zero
Protected env and override must exist now and their state snapshots must attest that both were absent before the failed deployment
PostgreSQL authority is bound to the exact Compose project, service, database and administrator recorded by the protected deployment metadata
If tai_runtime was controller-created, it may be dropped only after proving least-privilege flags, zero memberships, zero non-TAI relation grants and zero sessions after TAI removal
TAI migrations and bootstrap rows are retained as forward-only idempotent state; no production application data is rolled back
The recovery never mutates API/Web containers, model-host configuration, permanent model admission, tenants, business data or financial data
Only bounded sanitized health metadata is published; environment values, credentials, tokens, SQL contents and container logs are never published
REG.RU only and zero new recurring cost
